description:
Goal
Create per-executable ABI and backend products whose intermediate call targets remain symbolic ExecutableKey values.

Required shape
- AbiExecutableProduct(E) is derived from MaterializedExecutableProduct(E), TransportShapeProduct positions, CallableFactsProduct, and BoundaryFactsProduct.
- BackendExecutableProduct(E) lowers one ABI-ready executable to backend form without assigning dense root indices.
- ABI/backend products must not depend on AbiReadyProgram(root), EmissionReadyProgram(root), or any root-wide executable order.
- Dense usize targets are forbidden in these products. They belong only to final BackendProgram packaging.

Signal
A test asserts no dense index exists in per-executable artifacts and all inter-executable references are ExecutableKey until final packaging.

Removal target
New path does not call DeriveAbiReady or DeriveEmissionReady.

Verification
Targeted ABI/backend product tests, existing backend-interp tests through legacy path unchanged, cargo fmt --all, relevant compiler2 lib tests.
title: Pull path: add per-executable ABI and symbolic backend products
